nativePreservation: All accepted sources are copied byte-for-byte; no cropping, background replacement, alpha normalization or mirrored derivative PNG. Rejected attempts are not installed in the game.

facingReview.method: Per-image visual review; production renderer must combine source direction and actor direction.

limitations: Original static fan-game poses, not frame-by-frame animation or canonical episode certification.
Installed workbook remains at its preserved older revision; publication requires successful atomic export and reimport.
